points.en: Primary material: Steatite (soapstone); also terracotta, agate, chert, copper, faience.
points.hi: Primary material: Steatite (soapstone); also terracotta, agate, chert, copper, faience.

points.en: Rare materials: Gold, silver, ivory. Absence of iron.
points.hi: Rare materials: Gold, silver, ivory. Absence of iron.

points.en: Standard shapes: Mostly square (2x2 cm) with a perforated boss; rectangular, cylindrical, and circular variants exist.
points.hi: Standard shapes: Mostly square (2x2 cm) with a perforated boss; rectangular, cylindrical, and circular variants exist.

points.en: Manufacturing: Carved with micro-chisels, fired for hardening and whitish glaze.
points.hi: Manufacturing: Carved with micro-chisels, fired for hardening and whitish glaze.

points.en: Animal motifs: Unicorn (most common), humped bull, tiger, elephant, rhinoceros, bison, goat.
points.hi: Animal motifs: Unicorn (most common), humped bull, tiger, elephant, rhinoceros, bison, goat.

points.en: Notable absence: Horse is largely absent on mature Harappan seals (differs from later Vedic period).
points.hi: Notable absence: Horse is largely absent on mature Harappan seals (differs from later Vedic period).

points.en: Human & Composite: 'Pashupati' seal (proto-Shiva in yogic posture surrounded by animals), deity in pipal tree.
points.hi: Human & Composite: 'Pashupati' seal (proto-Shiva in yogic posture surrounded by animals), deity in pipal tree.

points.en: Inscriptions: Pictographic, undeciphered script, written boustrophedon (right-to-left then left-to-right).
points.hi: Inscriptions: Pictographic, undeciphered script, written boustrophedon (right-to-left then left-to-right).

points.en: Commercial role: Used as amulets, status symbols, and for stamping cargo (sealings) to prevent tampering.
points.hi: Commercial role: Used as amulets, status symbols, and for stamping cargo (sealings) to prevent tampering.

points.en: Mohenjo-daro: Yielded the famous Pashupati seal and Priest-King limestone image.
points.hi: Mohenjo-daro: Yielded the famous Pashupati seal and Priest-King limestone image.

points.en: Harappa: Produced numerous steatite animal seals and torso sculptures.
points.hi: Harappa: Produced numerous steatite animal seals and torso sculptures.

points.en: Dholavira: Unique large wooden signboard with Harappan script characters.
points.hi: Dholavira: Unique large wooden signboard with Harappan script characters.

explanation.en: Steatite material, Unicorn motif, Top script, Pashupati figure.
explanation.hi: Steatite material, Unicorn motif, Top script, Pashupati figure.

question.en: What was the most common material used for making Harappan seals?
question.hi: What was the most common material used for making Harappan seals?

question.en: What script direction was used on Indus Valley seals?
question.hi: सिंधु घाटी की मोहरों पर किस लिपि दिशा का उपयोग किया जाता था?

answer.hi: बौस्ट्रोफेडन (दाएँ से बाएँ और बाएँ से दाएँ वैकल्पिक)।

question.en: Which animal appears most frequently on Harappan seals?
question.hi: हड़प्पा की मोहरों पर कौन सा जानवर सबसे अधिक बार दिखाई देता है?

misconception.en: Horses were commonly depicted on IVC seals.
misconception.hi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता की मोहरों पर घोड़ों को आमतौर पर चित्रित किया गया था।

correction.en: Horses are extremely rare or absent on mature Harappan seals; the animal became prominent much later in the Vedic period.
correction.hi: परिपक्व हड़प्पा मोहरों पर घोड़े बेहद दुर्लभ हैं या अनुपस्थित हैं; वैदिक काल में यह जानवर बहुत बाद में प्रमुख हुआ।

misconception.en: Harappan script has been fully deciphered.
misconception.hi: हड़प्पा लिपि को पूरी तरह से पढ़ा जा चुका है।

correction.en: The script remains undeciphered to date.
correction.hi: यह लिपि आज तक अपठित बनी हुई है।

fiveFacts.en: Steatite was the principal medium for seal carving.
fiveFacts.hi: सेलखड़ी (स्टीटाइट) मोहर नक्काशी के लिए मुख्य माध्यम था।

fiveFacts.en: Seals featured a perforated boss on the reverse for cord attachment.
fiveFacts.hi: मोहरों के पिछले हिस्से पर धागा बांधने के लिए एक छिद्रयुक्त बॉस (उभार) होता था।

fiveFacts.en: The Pashupati seal depicts a seated yogic figure surrounded by wild animals.
fiveFacts.hi: पशुपति मोहर में जंगली जानवरों से घिरे एक बैठे हुए योग मुद्रा वाले व्यक्ति को दर्शाया गया है।

fiveFacts.en: Copper and terracotta seals/tablets were also utilized.
fiveFacts.hi: तांबे और टेराकोटा की मोहरों/गोलियों का भी उपयोग किया जाता था।

fiveFacts.en: Sealings found on clay lumps indicate administrative trade control.
fiveFacts.hi: मिट्टी के ढेरों पर पाई जाने वाली मोहरबंदियाँ प्रशासनिक व्यापार नियंत्रण को दर्शाती हैं।

threeTraps.en: Assuming iron was used for engraving (Iron Age was post-IVC).
threeTraps.hi: यह मान लेना कि उत्कीर्णन के लिए लोहे का उपयोग किया जाता था (लौह युग सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के बाद का था)।

threeTraps.en: Confusing the undeciphered script with Brahmi script.
threeTraps.hi: अपठित लिपि को ब्राह्मी लिपि समझ लेना।

threeTraps.en: Believing seals were exclusively used as currency.
threeTraps.hi: यह मानना कि मोहरों का उपयोग विशेष रूप से मुद्रा के रूप में किया जाता था।
